extracted.intended_audience: members of the press / journalists / media outlets
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for using images and contacting Google's press office from the 'Press Corner | The Keyword' page. Specifies how images may be used publicly and who is eligible to receive responses to press inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image usage and credit
rubrics_metrics.description: Images on this page may be used for publication with credit: "Source: Google."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Images are permitted for publication provided the credit line 'Source: Google.' is used. No additional usage terms are provided on this page; users should consult other Google policies for further restrictions if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press inquiry contact and eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: For press inquiries, email press@google.com. Only members of the press will receive a response.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact via the provided email is intended for members of the press; non-press inquiries will not receive a response. For non-press questions, the page directs users to visit Google's Help Center.
